metadata.title: High velocity stars from the interaction of a globular cluster and a massive black hole binary

notes: No eligible star-level entries. This is a theoretical scattering study of generic, initially bound test stars (e.g., a 1 M_sun test star) in globular-cluster–SMBHB simulations; the ejected stars discussed as possible HVSs are population members without individual names or identifiers, and the paper does not identify or follow up any specific Galactic unbound candidate.
